title: El-Sayed’s Campaign Doesn’t Want Haley Stevens at His Events
summary: Tensions have flared between Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan, and his former primary rival. “I don’t want any distractions,” Dr. El-Sayed said Saturday.
